hero.title: Where Ancient Wisdom Meets Ocean Breeze
hero.subtitle: Join our certified 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training and transformative retreats in the lush heart of Goa, India. Authentic Hatha, Pranayama, Meditation & Ashram Living.

philosophy.quote: Yoga is not about touching your toes. It is about what you learn on the way down.
philosophy.title: Rooted in Tradition, Open to the World
philosophy.text1: ONSRA Yoga Ashram is a sacred space in the heart of Goa, where ancient yogic wisdom meets the transformative power of the ocean. We offer immersive yoga teacher training and retreats for students from across the globe who seek an authentic, traditional experience.
philosophy.text2: Our 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course follows the classical Hatha Yoga tradition, taught by experienced masters in a living ashram environment — with organic meals, breathwork, philosophy, and community.

programs.title: 200-Hr Yoga Teacher Training
programs.description: An immersive, Yoga Alliance USA certified 200-Hour TTC covering classical Hatha, Pranayama, Meditation, Anatomy and Teaching Methodology. November 2026 & 2027 batches open.

programs.title: Nourish Her — Women's Wellness Retreat
programs.description: A sacred 3-day immersive retreat designed for women — exploring Hormonal Balance, Self-Love & Self-Confidence through yoga, pranayama, nutrition workshops and satsang.

programs.title: Ashram Stay & Practice
programs.description: Experience authentic ashram living in Goa — daily yoga, meditation, organic farm-to-table meals, sacred community and the healing energy of the ocean. Open for self-practice stays.

rooms.title: Shared Room
rooms.description: 2–4 beds per room in our comfortable shared ashram dormitory. Perfect for solo travelers looking to connect with the community.

rooms.title: Private Room
rooms.description: Your own quiet sanctuary — a private room with garden views, ideal for deep rest and self-study during the TTC.

rooms.title: Twin / Couple Room
rooms.description: Ideal for couples or friends attending together — a comfortable twin room with all ashram amenities.

about.title: ONSRA Yoga Ashram
about.description: Nestled in the lush tropical landscape of Goa, ONSRA Yoga Ashram is a sanctuary dedicated to the authentic transmission of traditional yoga.

testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell
testimonials.text: My 24 days at ONSRA Yoga Ashram completely transformed my life. The teachers are deeply knowledgeable, the ashram environment is pure magic, and learning traditional Hatha in Goa felt like coming home. I returned to London a certified teacher — and a changed person.

testimonials.name: Maria González
testimonials.text: I came as a complete beginner with no prior yoga experience. The teachers were incredibly patient and supportive. The curriculum was thorough — asana, pranayama, philosophy, anatomy — everything you need. Goa's energy made it extra special.

testimonials.name: Anika Weber
testimonials.text: The 'Nourish Her' retreat was a revelation. Three days of yoga, breathwork, workshops and beautiful community — all by the ocean in Goa. I left feeling deeply nourished, confident and reconnected to myself. Absolutely life-changing.

testimonials.name: Jessica Thompson
testimonials.text: As a yoga enthusiast from Australia, I wanted a traditional experience — and ONSRA delivered. The Hatha practice was deep and classical, the philosophy sessions opened my mind, and the Goa atmosphere was perfect. I'm already planning to come back.
